name: What types of decorative trim work do you offer for homes?

mainEntity.name: What types of decorative trim work do you offer for homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: We offer a range of decorative trim work, including crown molding, baseboards, window and door casings, wainscoting, and chair rails. Each type adds distinct architectural detail and character to a room. For example, crown molding can elegantly finish the transition between walls and ceilings, while wainscoting adds a classic paneling effect to lower wall sections. The right choice depends on the desired aesthetic and the architectural style of your home.
